## Terms

### MongoDB query planner, plan cache, query settings and hints

- **MongoDB query planner, plan cache, query settings and hints** · self

### query planner

- **query planner** · synonym — Hidden indexes are not visible to the query planner and cannot be used to support a query. · aka: query plan, query plans, planner, winning plan, winningPlan, rejected plans, rejectedPlans, candidate plans, plan selection, plan ranking — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-hidden/

### plan cache

- **plan cache** · part — Plan cache entries have three states. Missing: no entry exists, so plans are evaluated and an Inactive placeholder with a work value is created. Inactive: placeholder, not used to generate plans. Active: used to generate plans. A newly selected plan whose work value is less than or equal to the plac · aka: planCache, plan cache entry, plan cache key, planCacheKey, planCacheClear, $planCacheStats, planCacheShapeHash, plan cache eviction, replanning, replan — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/current/core/query-plans/

### query shape

- **query shape** · part — `planCacheKey` is a hash of the [plan cache query shape](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/glossary.md#std-term-plan-cache-query-shape), further distinguished by any available indexes for the shape. · aka: query shapes, queryShape, query hash, queryHash, queryShapeHash, $queryStats, queryStats, query stats, query statistics, queryStatsRateLimit, planSummary — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md#plancachekey

### query settings

- **query settings** · part — Query settings have more functionality than index filters. Also, index filters aren't persistent and you cannot easily create index filters for all cluster nodes. To add query settings and explore examples, see [`setQuerySettings`.](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setquerysetti · aka: setQuerySettings, removeQuerySettings, $querySettings, querySettings, index filters, index filter, planCacheSetFilter, planCacheListFilters, planCacheClearFilters, persistent query settings, query hints — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md#index-filters

### hint

- **hint** · part — hint() cannot select the index for a query containing a $text expression. · aka: hint(), cursor.hint, $hint, $natural, index hint, forcing an index, force index, forced index — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.hint.md

### $indexStats

- **$indexStats** · part · aka: indexStats, index stats, index usage, index usage statistics, unused index, unused indexes, accesses.ops, dropIndex, drop unused index

### database profiler

- **database profiler** · part · aka: profiler, db.setProfilingLevel, setProfilingLevel, profiling level, system.profile, slowms, slowOpThresholdMs, slow query log, slowOpSampleRate, log slow operations, COLLSCAN, collection scan, COLLSCAN stage, slow query log, Slow query entries, slow query entries

### slot-based execution engine

- **slot-based execution engine** · related · aka: SBE, slot based execution, classic engine, classic query engine, query framework control, internalQueryFrameworkControl, express path, express execution

### $currentOp

- **$currentOp** · related · aka: currentOp, db.currentOp, killOp, long-running operations, maxTimeMS

### query optimization

- **query optimization** · hypernym · aka: query performance, optimize queries, query optimizer, analyze query performance

### index

- **index** · hypernym — Index properties affect how the query planner uses an index and how indexed documents are stored. You can specify index properties as optional parameters when you create an index. · aka: indexes, indices, indexing — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-properties.md
